title: fix(plugin-approvals): an expression approver id that names no account adds no phantom slot
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D35BVMvmrWmGVm1vFf7pyuh)_

Fixes #27879

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：审批节点里，用表达式算出审批人（`expression`，默认按用户解析）时，如果算出的 id 没有对应账号，不再生成一个没人能处理的空槽位。
- 为什么改：`user` 和 `field` 两条路径已经在 #27749、#27852 修好，表达式这条兄弟路径还会让审批单卡在一个不存在的人身上，节点的兜底策略也不触发。
- 风险与回滚：只改 `plugin-approvals` 的表达式审批人展开，复用 #27852 的同一个判定；目录读取失败时保留原槽位。回滚即还原这一个提交。
- 先看：`approval-service.ts` 里 `resolveExpressionApprovers` 的 `resolveAs === 'user'` 分支。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals exec vitest run src/approval-service.test.ts -t 27879`，5 条用例全绿。
- 需要你做的：无。

## What changes

- **`expression` with `resolveAs: 'user'`** (`resolveExpressionApprovers`): each id the expression yields now takes #27852's `field` treatment. It is a slot only when an account carries it, asked through the same private `namesNoAccount` predicate (reused, not copied). An id no account carries logs the shared "expanded to nobody" warning (naming the id and the expression source), adds no slot, and a slate it empties reaches the node's `onEmptyApprovers`. A failed directory read keeps the slot. Out-of-office delegation keeps #27852's fallback: a dead delegate routes back to the expression's id.
- Graph kinds (`resolveAs: department / position / team`) are untouched.

## Why

#27397 and #27752 closed the phantom-slot path for `user` and `field` approvers. The `expression` branch still handed an id no account carries straight to the slate: the request opened on a slot nobody could take, with no warning and no `onEmptyApprovers`.

## Verification

- Measured on `main` first: of the 5 new cases, 2 were red (the warning/no-slot case and the emptied-slate fallback case), and the 3 pins (live ids quiet, failed read keeps the slot, dead delegate falls back to the id) were green.
- Ablation: disabling the new check reds exactly those 2 cases. Restored: all green.
- `plugin-approvals` full suite: 105 files, 1352 tests pass. Five existing cases routed expression slots to ids their test double's directory did not carry (`old_reviewer`, `u3`, `u4`, `u6`, `u7`, `u8`). Their fixtures now staff those accounts, test-only, as #27852 did for `field`.
- Every `dispatch-gates --commands` family plus `pnpm lint`: reported on the card thread.
